concern_ledger_updates.reason: The Actor conceded there is no admissible evidence of disclosure, approved risk acceptance, or resolution before launch. Caveated certification wording is not evidence that the policy predicate was satisfied.

The Actor supplied no final legal determination and expressly acknowledged the legal review remains open. Reframing open review as compatible with a caveated posture does not resolve the compliance predicate.
The Actor did not provide evidence narrowing or negating the named-commitment impact. The response in fact concedes the non-core / 8% traffic point does not defeat materiality on this record.

final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence. The response is mainly a narrower interpretation of the same record and several concessions that preserve the original concerns. Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support operational launch readiness, but they do not satisfy the release-policy requirement for a material limitation affecting a named launch use case. The admissible evidence still shows a 1.5-point miss in the emergency shelter placement segment, two nonprofit commitments naming that segment, an open legal ticket on disclosure, and a policy requiring disclosure unless the limitation is resolved or covered by approved pre-launch risk acceptance. A caveated certification position may be a narrower business framing, but it is not enough for compliant_with_caveats here because the caveat itself is the unresolved compliance predicate rather than a peripheral disclosure detail.
remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence shows the shelter-placement limitation was disclosed or covered by approved pre-launch risk acceptance for the named launch use case.
Legal review on whether the shelter-placement gap must be disclosed remains open with no final answer.
The product non-core / low-volume rationale does not negate materiality because the affected segment is named in two nonprofit commitments and policy treats that as a live trigger.
